scope: Enabled chapter-two and chapter-three ordinary node stories; candidate display translations with exact original-text guards, IDs and rules unchanged.

main:scene:2:node:201.text:
2—1 大道要塞

侦察兵报告，哥布林与食人魔的袭击来自西面的冰封要塞。精灵还带来消息：你的儿时伙伴艾蕾莱公主已被劫为人质。必须尽快救出她！
main:scene:2:node:201.originalText:
2-1 Highway Fort


Scouts report that the Goblin & Ogre raids came from the icy fortresses to the west. You've also heard from the Elves that your childhood companion, Princess Erelei has been taken hostage. You must rescue her quickly!
main:scene:2:node:201.source: main taskdes.ID 201001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:202.text:
2—2 山腰哨塔

哨塔已被哥布林占领，空气中弥漫着血腥与污秽的气息。拿起武器，夺回哨塔！
main:scene:2:node:202.originalText:
2-2 Hillside Sentry Tower


The sentry tower has been captured by Goblins, and reeks of blood and filth. Grab your weapons and take it back!
main:scene:2:node:202.source: main taskdes.ID 202001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:203.text:
2—3 丘陵山路

食人魔挡住了去路。冲上结冰的山坡时务必小心，失足滑落与食人魔的钉锤同样致命！
main:scene:2:node:203.originalText:
2-3 Hilly Mountain Road


Ogres bar your path, take care as you charge on the icy slope, a fall here is just as deadly as an Ogre's Mace!
main:scene:2:node:203.source: main taskdes.ID 203001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:204.text:
2—4 石砌废墟

哥布林在这片古老废墟中筑起了巢穴。净化此地，摧毁它们的污秽巢穴！
main:scene:2:node:204.originalText:
2-4 Stone Ruins


The Goblins have made a lair in these ancient ruins. Purify this site and destroy their filthy nest!
main:scene:2:node:204.source: main taskdes.ID 204001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:205.text:
2—5 安息之地

这里是袭击者的集结地。敞开的空围栏里，堆满了不幸俘虏被啃食后的残骨。狂暴猎犬虽已饱食腐尸，也不会放过新鲜的猎物。
main:scene:2:node:205.originalText:
2-5 Resting Grounds


A staging ground for raids, empty pens stand open, filled with the gnawed bones of unlucky captives. Even though the frenzied hounds have been feasting on rotting corpses, they won't pass up the chance to eat a fresh kill.
main:scene:2:node:205.source: main taskdes.ID 205001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:206.text:
2—6 覆雪山坡

一队卫兵突然袭击了你的武装护卫队。他们似乎乐于相信这里正在发生武装叛乱。也许只有一次彻底的失败，才能让他们今后传递准确的情报。
main:scene:2:node:206.originalText:
2-6 Snow-covered Slope


A party of Guardsmen unexpectedly assaults your armed escort. They seem happy with the illusion of an armed rebellion. Perhaps a decisive defeat will make them supply correct information in the future.
main:scene:2:node:206.source: main taskdes.ID 206001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:207.text:
2—7 刃脊山道

哨兵奉命不许任何人通过。看来，只能用武力闯过去了……
main:scene:2:node:207.originalText:
2-7 Knifes-Edge Mountain Path


Sentries have been instructed not to let anyone pass. Looks like you're going to have to go through them the hard way...
main:scene:2:node:207.source: main taskdes.ID 207001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:2:node:208.text:
2—8 雪原要塞

雪原要塞的大门紧闭，克劳德指挥官满怀敌意。想救出精灵公主艾蕾莱，唯有彻底击败他。
main:scene:2:node:208.originalText:
2-8 Snowy Fort


The gates of the Snowy Fort are locked tight. Commander Claude is seething with enmity. The only way to rescue the elven princess, Erelei, is by soundly defeating him.
main:scene:2:node:208.source: main taskdes.ID 208001; English source in current imported configuration; display translation only

main:scene:3:node:301.text:
3—1 雪山道路

艾蕾莱是精灵改革派的领袖，希望改善人类与精灵的关系。为表支持，你答应护送她返回族人身边。这条路漫长而危险，还要穿过半精灵的领地。
main:scene:3:node:301.originalText:
3-1 Snowy Mountain Road


Erelei is the leader of the Elven reformists and wants good relations between Humans and Elves and to support that, you've offered to escort her back to her people. The road is a long and dangerous one, through Halfblood lands.
main:scene:3:node:301.source: main taskdes.ID 301001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:302.text:
3—2 洞窟隧道

途中，艾蕾莱告诉你，绑架是反对她理念的人策划的阴谋之一……前方洞穴里回荡着毒蝙蝠的尖啸，小心！
main:scene:3:node:302.originalText:
3-2 Cavern Tunnel


On the road, Erelei tells you that her kidnapping is part of a plot from those who oppose her ideals... The caverns up ahead are alive with the whistling of poisonous Bats, take care!
main:scene:3:node:302.source: main taskdes.ID 302001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:303.text:
3—3 洞口

艾蕾莱刚提到，她的妹妹与其他精灵驻守在一座要塞，却不认同她的政治主张。刺耳的蜥蜴叫声突然响起，伏兵来了！击退袭击车队的装甲蜥蜴！
main:scene:3:node:303.originalText:
3-3 Cave Mouth


Erelei has just mentioned that her younger sister is garrisoned at a fort with other Elves but doesn't share her political views, when all of a sudden the piercing Lizard screeches announce an ambush! Drive off the Armoured Lizards attacking the convoy!
main:scene:3:node:303.source: main taskdes.ID 303001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:304.text:
3—4 雾山

浓雾笼罩着精灵圣山的山脚。蹒跚的身影从雾中出现，发出骇人的嚎叫。亡灵挡住了去路——这些可怕的生物为何突然出现在这里？
main:scene:3:node:304.originalText:
3-4 Foggy Mountain


Dense fog covers the feet of the holy Elven mountains. Shambling figures emerge from the fog, screaming terrifying howls. The Undead block the way - why have these dreadful creatures suddenly appeared?
main:scene:3:node:304.source: main taskdes.ID 304001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:305.text:
3—5 小松林

阴暗的树林里闪烁着令人畏缩的光芒。潜伏的幽魂冲出来发动袭击，你必须坚守阵地……
main:scene:3:node:305.originalText:
3-5 Lesser Pine Forest


Lights flicker inside the gloomy forest that makes people flinch, but you must stand your ground as hidden Spirits rush forth to attack...
main:scene:3:node:305.source: main taskdes.ID 305001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:306.text:
3—6 温泉林地

一群食尸鬼与幽魂出现在温泉林间。这场凶险的伏击似乎是冲着艾蕾莱公主来的……
main:scene:3:node:306.originalText:
3-6 Hot Spring Woodlands


A throng of Ghouls and Spirits appear in the hot spring glades, this menacing ambush seems directed at princess Erelei...
main:scene:3:node:306.source: main taskdes.ID 306001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:307.text:
3—7 艾尔河浅滩

获救的精灵告诉你，精灵族正在内战。艾蕾莱离开部族后，妹妹萨里亚发动政变，反对王室。如今，艾蕾莱的生命正受到威胁……
main:scene:3:node:307.originalText:
3-7 Aire River Ford


A rescued Elf tells you of the civil war among the Elven Nation. After Pricess Erelei left the tribes, her younger sister Sarya led a coup against the crown. At present, Erelei's life is in peril...
main:scene:3:node:307.source: main taskdes.ID 307001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese

main:scene:3:node:308.text:
3—8 森林入口

前方是著名的北风飞马骑兵！他们是精灵保守派主力的先锋，显然是来阻止精灵公主返回的。
main:scene:3:node:308.originalText:
3-8 Forest Entrance


Up ahead stand the famous North Wind Pegasi riders! They're the vanguard for the main forces of the conservative Elven tribes. They must be here to obstruct the Elven princess from returning.
main:scene:3:node:308.source: main taskdes.ID 308001; current imported English text; display only, not recovered official Chinese
